business_problem: Technology solutions provider CDW Corporation (CDW) is embracing generative AI to power employee productivity and accelerate customers’ AI journeys.
solution_summary: CDW used Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, GitHub Copilot to surface grounded answers from enterprise knowledge faster. Technology solutions provider CDW Corporation (CDW) is embracing generative AI to power employee productivity and accelerate customers’ AI journeys. Key implementation elements included Microsoft 365 Copilot applies AI to documents, meetings, mail, and other everyday knowledge work; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; GitHub Copilot accelerates software delivery with AI-assisted code generation and review; Microsoft Azure hosts the application, data, and integrations on scalable cloud infrastructure. Enterprise content from documents, meetings, websites, or internal systems is passed through retrieval and model services so users receive grounded answers inside the target workflow. The solution also connects with ERP, helping the new platform fit into existing operations. Source metrics...
